featureRows.title: Define reproducible browser performance fixtures and milestones
featureRows.recordedDisposition: Recommended core integration or verification, with improvements preferred over literal Arc replication.
featureRows.sourceReferenceLimit: Dia release evidence is mostly macOS, with explicitly cited Windows entries. No Linux reference or reproducible vendor benchmark.
featureRows.crossCuttingRequirement: Assess every affected surface against cross-cutting-scenarios.json; no implicit N/A.

scenarios.criterion: Document fixtures, process accounting and milestones for startup, input-to-visible activation, navigation, command search, scrolling, memory and idle work.
Control hardware/OS/build, engine/settings, ad blocking/extensions, account/network and cache state; include a matched fork/Helium baseline.
Separate perceived-response, input-ready, paint, network completion and quiescence, retain raw traces/distributions, and leave numerical targets to evidence and owner needs.

scenarios.criterion: Trace selection, focus and destination paint separately from destruction/cleanup work before and after the change.

First identify a measured local bottleneck. If native Helium already meets the contract, retain the proven baseline and focused regression coverage rather than adding speculative mechanisms.

Measure idle memory and reactivation latency and test interruption/restart.
First identify a measured local bottleneck. If native Helium already meets the contract, retain the proven baseline and focused regression coverage rather than adding speculative mechanisms.
Account for service workers, extensions and Profile-owned background tasks before calling a Profile unused.
